summary: UI PR image check accepts en/em/hyphen dashes in the visual-evidence escape hatch and warns (instead of failing open silently) when .agentic/ui-paths.yml is malformed.
migration_impact: No action required; existing globs and escape-hatch bodies keep working. A malformed .agentic/ui-paths.yml now emits a warning and falls back to built-in defaults.
agent_notes: `Visual evidence: not applicable <dash> <reason>` accepts em dash, en dash, or hyphen. Malformed ui-paths.yml warns on stderr and uses DEFAULT_UI_GLOBS.
